boardQuestion: Where is Microsoft identity spend drifting because entitlements and premium tiers are not being reclaimed tightly enough?
driftNarrative: Microsoft identity is strategically important, though license overlap is still leaking money across adjacent admin layers.
operatingReality: Coverage is strong, but too many overlapping SKUs and sticky assignments are weakening the cost story.
riskHeadline: Board-visible platform maturity is arriving faster than access-spend discipline.
driftSignal: Premium entitlements stay attached after role changes, and review cycles do not reclaim them fast enough.
blockingIssue: One role transition still leaves too many residual licenses and duplicated control assignments behind.
headline: Microsoft identity is strong, but license overlap is still too expensive.
nextMove: Create one reclaim-first entitlement packet for every role or device transition above the premium-access threshold.
